The '''Anthos sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories near [[Orus sector/Legends|Orus sector]]. Planets in Anthos included [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]].

The [[Tunroth]] [[Tunroth Hunter|Hunter]] [[Tonas Vueral]] worked in the Anthos sector.
